main_text.head: REVERENDIS CLARISSIMISQVE VIRIS
main_text.p: Dn.Ioanni Prideavxio SS.Theol. D. ac ce-leberrimæ Magnæ Britanniæ, quæ est Oxonij, A-cademiæ Professori Regio, & ibidem Collegij Ex-onienfis Rectori dignissimo, patrono ac fautori suo omni tempore suspiciendo.
Dn.Pavlo Tossano SS.Theol. D. & Senatus Ecclesiastici in inferiori Palatinatu Consiliario, Adfini suo honorando.
main_text.head: NEC NON
main_text.p: Clarissimo Charissimoqve Dn.Frideri-co Dorvillio SS.Theol. L. ac Illustrissimi Florentissimique Principis, ac Domini, Domini Henrici Iacobi Serenissimi Bohemiæ Regis, &c. Filij primogeniti Inspectori sedulo, fratri suo plurimum colendo.
Hanc suam De Sacramentis Dispu-tationem In grati animi ac debitæ obseruantiæ

page.notes: The Greek word before D.D.D.C.Q. is hard to read at this scan resolution; the reading τεκμήριον is tentative. The Q of D.D.D.C.Q. appears underlined in the print. The line-end hyphens in "ce-leberrimæ", "A-cademiæ", "Ex-onienfis", "Frideri-co" and "Dispu-tationem" are the printer's own.
